paper.title: Lu,Jin & Karniadakis (2019 preprint),DeepONet:Learning nonlinear operators
paper.scope: Supervised teaching adaptation:fixed three-sine forcing family maps to zero-endpoint Poisson temperature.24training functions x12label locations;9input sensors;unstacked rank8 DeepONet,linear-branch engineering prior,and concatenation baseline. Hard boundary factors are added. Not original GRF or broad nonlinear-operator benchmarks;no universal extrapolation claim.

sources.name: Lu,Jin & Karniadakis (2019 preprint),DeepONet:Learning nonlinear operators
sources.text: Primary unstacked branch/trunk architecture and operator-approximation motivation. The theorem concerns representational approximation,not guaranteed optimisation or arbitrary extrapolation. Our finite three-sine Poisson family,hard-boundary wrapper and linear-branch control are teaching adaptations.
